# **OFFICE ORDER** 

# **Sub: Constitution of Committee to evaluate applications filed under IRDAI (Regulatory Sandbox) Regulations, 2019 - Extension of term of the Committee** 

The Authority, vide office order No: IRDAI/ INT/ ORD/ Reg. Sandbox/195/10/2029 dated 25th October, 2019, has constituted a Committee to evaluate applications filed under IRDAI (Regulatory Sandbox) Regulations, 2019 for a term of one year. 

the tenure of the said Committee by one more year, i.e., up to 24th October, 2021. In view of the working undertaken by the Committee, the Chairman, IRDAI has extended 

All the other terms and conditions stated in the order dated 25th October, 2019 remain unaltered. 

(M. PuUa -Rao) Executive Director (Gen.)
